result.title: SpinSCI: Mask-Conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer for Video Snapshot Compressive Imaging
result.summary: Video snapshot compressive imaging (SCI) recovers multiple frames from one spatiotemporally coded measurement. This paper proposes SpinSCI, a mask-conditioned Spatial-Temporal Spin Transformer whose Mask-Conditioned Ising Refinement Block (MC-IRB) combines attention logits and sensing information to form signed spin couplings. Finite mean-field updates gate residual feature refinement. Physics-guided initialization and final data consistency incorporate the measurement model. Compared with HiSViT$_9$, SpinSCI achieves average PSNR gains of 0.51 dB, 0.23 dB, and 0.04 dB on small-scale gray, mid-scale color, and large-scale color benchmarks, respectively, with 16.9% fewer parameters, 21.0-21.6% fewer FLOPs, 17.1-49.9% lower latency, and 62.3-63.3% lower peak memory. Relative to DU-9stg, average PSNR differs by at most 0.13 dB across these benchmarks, with 28.2-28.7% fewer FLOPs, 64.6-71.7% lower inference latency, and 30.1-35.0% lower peak memory. Qualitative comparisons on the real benchmark further show recovery of fine details and textures. Code and reference checkpoints are available at https://github.com/skethz/SpinSCI.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SpinSCI，一种掩码条件化的时空 spin Transformer，用于从单次编码测量重建视频快照压缩成像的多帧：用 Ising 平均场有限步更新门控残差特征细化，并结合物理引导初始化与末端数据一致性，主打低参数量与低显存、低延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其有限步平均场迭代加测量数据一致的「能量式」特征更新与终止结构，可能为 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态细化及停止／收敛判据提供可核查线索，但属低层视频重建，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
